No institutional full-text access is required for the gate; full text remains a later evidence-depth upgrade, not a gate blocker.

rulings.decision: evidence_url is the locator column; exact_locator is query-provenance. G-LIT's 'resolvable locators' criterion is read per-row against evidence_url. rulings.falsifier: A row whose evidence_url does not resolve, or a G-LIT verdict relying on exact_locator uniqueness.
